notes:
The second tablet can be updated from the first.

**When you install an update on the main tablet, it now offers the same update to the paired tablet.** The second tablet no longer needs to be connected to a network at all.

That matters for transfers: the two tablets talk to each other directly, and the second tablet has to follow whichever channel the first one chooses. If it is joined to a network that pins it elsewhere — as a workplace network often does — the direct connection between them can fail. App updates were the only remaining reason for the second tablet to join a network.

Both tablets must be on 0.44 or later for this to work. Android will still ask you to confirm the install on the second tablet; that cannot be skipped, and the second tablet will not accept an update while a piece is open.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
